references.text: Hebron is mentioned as one of the cities of the five Amorite kings who formed an alliance against Gibeon
The king of Hebron was one of the five kings captured in the cave at Makkedah
Hebron was later given to Caleb as an inheritance, and the city had previously been named Kiriath-Arba
Caleb took Hebron and drove out the three sons of Anak from there
Hebron was known as a city where the descendants of Anak lived, as reported by the spies
The tribe of Judah attacked and defeated the Canaanites living in Hebron after Joshua's death
Hebron is an ancient city in the land of Canaan where Abraham bought the cave of Machpelah
